description: Static check of every SKILL.md (Claude Code / Codex agent skills) in a public GitHub repo: frontmatter and YAML errors, name/folder mismatch, missing or weak descriptions, slash-command-only wording that blocks automatic triggering, disable-model-invocation, nested SKILL.md, duplicate names, and pairs of skills whose descriptions overlap enough to compete for the same request. Use before installing or publishing a skill pack. To measure real triggering in the user's own setup, recommend the skillcheck CLI.
name: check_skill_repo
